nodes.summary: Every point of finite order in $E(K_0)$ lies in $E(K_0)[2]=\{O,(0,0),(d,0),(-d,0)\}$. Thus the torsion subgroup of $E(K_0)$ is $E(K_0)[2]$, of order $4$ and isomorphic to $(\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z)^2$. The same holds for $C(K_0)$, whose torsion subgroup is $C(K_0)[2]=\{O,(0,0),(\delta,0),(-\delta,0)\}$.
